title: Field Engineer: Cryogenics & RF Hardware
description: Operates, monitors, and troubleshoots dilution refrigerators and custom RF microwave control systems for superconducting quantum processors during system deployments.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Cryogenic
description: Owns mechanical architecture of quantum hardware systems down to millikelvin stages, designing cryogenic enclosures and thermal anchors for superconducting qubits.

title: Lead Quantum Engineer, Systems Performance
description: Leads technical efforts in benchmarking, tuning, and calibrating multi-qubit superconducting quantum processors to optimize 1Q/2Q gate fidelities and coherence metrics.

title: Cryogenic Electrical Interconnect Engineer
description: Designs and validates high-density electrical interconnect solutions, flexible PCB harnesses, and low-thermal-load cabling spanning room temperature to sub-4K cryogenic stages.

title: Cryostat Equipment Engineer
description: Directs the assembly, commissioning, vacuum leak testing, and operational maintenance of large-scale cryogenic systems housing superconducting single-photon detectors.

title: Photonics Circuit Designer
description: Designs, models, and optimizes complex silicon photonic integrated circuits for quantum light manipulation, optical routing, and electro-optic modulation.

title: Physicist - Ion Transport and Waveform Design
description: Develops and optimizes electromagnetic potential landscapes and control waveforms for ion shuttling, transport, and multi-qubit gate operations in surface-electrode ion traps.

title: Quantum Design Enablement Engineer
description: Enables seamless transfer of trapped-ion quantum chip architectures to external foundries by building automated physical verification rules, PDKs, and layout generators.

title: Optical Integration Engineer
description: Integrates and tests precision optical assemblies, free-space delivery systems, and laser delivery modules utilized in trapped-ion quantum computing.

title: Cryogenic & RF Platform Operations Manager
description: Manages operational readiness, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting across a fleet of dilution refrigerators and RF measurement chains supporting cat-qubit quantum hardware.

title: Senior RF Engineer - Quantum Control
description: Designs custom RF hardware front-ends, filters, LNAs, and PCBs to generate ultra-low-noise microwave control pulses for Schrödinger cat qubits.

title: Expert Quantum Physicist
description: Leads mathematical modeling and numerical simulation for bosonic cat-qubit chips, bridging fundamental Hamiltonian physics with fault-tolerant quantum error correction.

title: Cryogenic RF Engineer
description: Designs, models, and tests cryogenic RF transmission lines, filters, and high-frequency interconnect assemblies delivering control signals to superconducting quantum chips.

title: Experimental Physicist II - Scalable Processors
description: Performs cryogenic low-temperature measurements and noise characterization on multi-qubit superconducting chips to advance scalable gate-model and annealing quantum architectures.

title: Scientific Software Engineer - Hardware Compilation
description: Develops intermediate representations, compilers, and hardware emulation pipelines converting quantum algorithms into laser control sequences for neutral-atom QPUs.

title: Quantum Solutions Scientist
description: Researches and formulates optimization, chemistry, and simulation applications on neutral-atom quantum processors, conducting resource estimation and algorithm co-design.

title: R&D Scientist, Quantum Algorithms
description: Designs and implements novel quantum algorithms and error mitigation techniques for trapped-ion systems, focusing on PDEs, topological data analysis, and scientific computing benchmarks.

title: Photonics Engineer - Experimentalist
description: Constructs and characterizes free-space and fiber-integrated optical setups generating continuous-variable squeezed quantum states of light for photonic quantum computing.
